blocks.text: Most serious sting-related reactions are caused by insects of the order Hymenoptera, particularly: Bees, Wasps and Ants. Other arthropods/venomous creatures that may also cause bites or stings include: Spiders, Scorpions, Centipedes, Millipedes.
Localized pain at the bite/sting site, Swelling, Redness, Itching. Severe reactions may include: Generalized urticaria, Angioedema, Wheezing, Difficulty breathing, Hypotension, Anaphylaxis.

blocks.text: For Centipedes Ensure your patient’s tetanus vaccination is up to date.

blocks.text: Scorpion stings can cause severe local pain and systemic toxicity. Children are at higher risk of severe envenoming and death compared to adults.
